entry_state._derivation: DERIVED 2026-09-20: a book's entry state is the preceding book's exit state. B0N entry = B0N-1 exit, so this cites BB01's exit_state_locks rather than restating them - one source, not two. Structural coordinates only; the grid holds the descriptions. Inherits status `proposed` from those grid rows. Regenerate rather than hand-edit. Ledger section 60.
entry_state._status: proposed - inherited from the grid rows
entry_state.world: DERIVED: the world as B01 leaves it. See book_context_B01.json exit_state_locks: M01, M02, M03.
entry_state.key_character_states: DERIVED: as B01 leaves them. Character-level state is not carried in the milestone grid, which records events rather than per-character condition. What IS derivable is cited above; per-character detail needs either a character-arc layer (none exists yet - CLAUDE.md section 8.0 lists character arcs as genuinely unstructured) or an author pass. Not invented here.

exit_state_locks._derivation: DERIVED 2026-09-20 from grids/milestones_payoffs.csv: the milestones landing in this book are what it locks on exit. Structural coordinates only (milestone, act, episode); the grid holds the descriptions. All 36 rows are status `proposed`, so every lock here inherits that status. Regenerate rather than hand-edit. Ledger section 59.
exit_state_locks._status: proposed - inherited from the grid rows

locations_in_play._derivation: DERIVED 2026-09-20 under Ruling 8: assignments are populated and marked PROVISIONAL IN THE FIELD rather than left empty. The place roster and every place-to-type assignment live in grids/locations_registry.csv, which carries the two-layer structure of Ruling 1 - the geography system supplies TYPES, city bibles supply NAMES that map onto a type. Contested ground (Tremé, Marigny, French Quarter, Bywater, Red Lantern Faultline) is assigned there, not omitted. `match` distinguishes an exact place-name hit from an alias inference such as "the swamp" -> Honey Island Swamp. Ledger section 61.
locations_in_play._gap: PER-BOOK ROSTER IS NOT DERIVABLE AND IS NOT INVENTED HERE. No source maps places to books. The milestone grid names a location in only 3 of 9 books, so the entries below are the places this book's own milestones NAME - a floor, never a complete roster, and an empty list means no milestone in this book names a place, NOT that the book has no locations. Ruling 8 authorises deriving the TYPE layer, which is done; it does not supply a book dimension that no source contains. Listing the full 31-place roster under every book would assert that every place appears in every book, which is false. OPEN: a per-book location pass needs a source that does not yet exist. See CLAUDE.md section 4.

escalation_permissions.derivation: Union of the three act bands beneath this book (S1.T1.B02.A1/.A2/.A3): min of mins, max of maxes, per axis. No judgement was applied to any value. Regenerate rather than hand-edit: if an act band changes, this block is stale.
escalation_permissions.source: act_overlays/ rolled up 2026-09-20; the act values themselves come from proposals/concord-2026/ENVELOPE_INTERIM_VALUES_V2_2026-09-19.md

continuity_hooks._derivation: DERIVED 2026-09-20 from grids/milestones_payoffs.csv `required_setups`, which encodes 54 dependency edges, 33 of them cross-book, with zero dangling and zero backward references. A cross-book dependency IS a continuity hook. Regenerate rather than hand-edit: if the grid changes, this block is stale. Milestone IDs are cited rather than described - the grid holds the descriptions, and duplicating them here would create a second copy to drift. Ledger section 59.
